verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can integrate Skyvern with Python, TypeScript, or REST (skyvern-docs-1). They describe a code-first Skyvern SDK that layers AI on top of Playwright over CDP (skyvern-docs-5, skyvern-docs-19), with concrete SDK methods such as `page.extract` and `page.agent.run_task` (skyvern-docs-4, skyvern-docs-20). missing for 10: SDK package/install and API-reference detail, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
